<cite ref="Yevamot 76a:16">Yeb. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>גּיּיוּרֵי גַּיְּירָהּ</he> he made her an Israelite.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 76">Gen. R. s. 76</cite>, end <he>לאו גַּיַּירְתֵּיה</he> would she not have converted him?; a. e.

senses.gloss: to become a Jew, to embrace the Israelitish faith, to be converted.
